credentialPatterns: No matches for private keys, GitHub/OpenAI token shapes, JWTs, populated auth secrets or signed transfer URLs.
excluded: No .git, node_modules, generated builds/caches, credentials, live snapshots, media, real approvals or customer input content included. Source manifest contains paths/hashes only. Logs are isolated/synthetic test output.
manualReview: Reviewed patch additions, README, source manifest metadata, and local test/build logs.
limitations: Pattern scan is evidence, not a guarantee against all possible secrets.
